name: What is the cost range for deck board replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost range for deck board replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of deck board replacement varies significantly based on factors such as the deck's size, the type of material selected (e.g., pressure-treated wood vs. composite), the complexity of the deck design, and any necessary repairs to the substructure. Generally, materials like pressure-treated pine are more economical than high-end composites or exotic hardwoods. Labor costs also contribute to the total. Maine Results, Inc. provides a detailed estimate after a site visit, which allows us to accurately assess your specific deck, material preferences, and any unforeseen challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Deck board replacement costs vary widely based on deck size, material choice, design complexity, and any substructure repairs needed.
